# Private instance calls with a covariant producer and fixed nominal result

The owned formatter has one independent Object-bounded method formal in a
complete covariant producer, one closed String context, and a String result.
Immutable callers and reflection preserve the private instance descriptor and
full Signature. The observer checks opaque/null/array/marker values, Object
overload selection, callback and formatting order, mutable receiver state,
context identity, and exact RuntimeException/Error identity.

Source and borrowed-producer profiles independently inventory every definition,
compile all recovered Java, and preserve full original metadata/Exceptions.
Signature mutations and independent wrong implementations must fail the frozen
observer. Only these owned programs execute.
